items.s: Another one of yours: most of the gains in life come from suffering in the short term so you can get paid in the long term.

sort of using suffering as the proxy for progress as opposed to the outcome of the suffering. Right?

items.c: on the other side of it
items.zh: 在它的另一边（之后得到的）
items.s: I have attached well-being and satisfaction to pain, not to what the pain gets me on the other side of it.
If you define pain as physical pain, then it’s a real thing, it happens, and you can’t ignore it, but that’s not what we mean by suffering.

items.c: You hear from a lot of successful people
items.zh: 你会听很多成功人士说
items.s: You hear from a lot of successful people, they look back and they say, “Oh the journey was the fun part.”
